trim_silence.description: Trim silence before the first and after the last voiced frame (SWIPE, F0 settings): phonation (phonation task only), always, never. Not applied with VAD

trim_margin.description: Margin kept before and after the voice when trimming (s)

delta_step.description: Deltas: for regression the width of the regression window (frames), for difference the lag of c(t) − c(t − delta_step)

filterbank.description: Filter bank: slaney = fixed edges 133–6854 Hz as in MATLAB mfcc (default); mel = mel bank from 0 Hz to Nyquist as in version 1.x

delta_method.description: Deltas: regression = regression line over delta_step frames (default, as 1.x); difference = c(t) − c(t − delta_step) as MATLAB; difference_padded = the same including the zero rows at the end, MATLAB verbatim

outlier_threshold.description: Outlier frames by c0: strict = distance against the square root of the chi-square quantile (default, as 1.x); matlab = against the quantile without the root, removes fewer frames

std_ddof.description: Standard deviation: 1 = sample (n − 1) as MATLAB (default), 0 = as 1.x
